description: This PHP file defines the MembershipService class which manages operations related to memberships in the HRM system, including CRUD operations and normalization.

classes.name: MembershipService
classes.description: Service class for handling membership-related business logic, utilizing DAO for data access and normalization traits for data processing.

methods.name: getMembershipDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and retrieves the MembershipDao instance.

methods.name: setMembershipDao
methods.description: Sets a specific instance of MembershipDao, useful for dependency injection.

methods.name: saveMembership
methods.description: Saves a Membership entity to the database via DAO.

methods.name: getMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves a Membership by its ID.

methods.name: getMembershipByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Membership by its name.

methods.name: getMembershipList
methods.description: Fetches a list of memberships based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getMembershipCount
methods.description: Returns the count of memberships matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteMemberships
methods.description: Deletes multiple memberships by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingMembershipName
methods.description: Checks if a membership name already exists.

methods.name: getMembershipArray
methods.description: Retrieves all memberships and normalizes them into an array format.
